system.description:
Deal [(SR+1)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage to the target, and the target takes [Dazed].

(Target: Flying): Increase the damage by +10.

A special skill that allows you to change the trajectory of your attack by lightly flipping your body around, like a swallow, and catch your enemy by surprise. In particular, flying enemies will be at the mercy of its behavior and will suffer great damage.
